title: Dancing It Up
style: Jazz with the bass line carrying the melody: walking upright bass or melodic fretless bass in the foreground, warm Rhodes comping, brushed snare, ride cymbal, and sparse piano voicings. Vocals drift above with close-mic breathiness, light tape saturation, soft room reverb, and subtle counterline horn phrases.
lyrics:
[Intro]
One, two, three, four
We're dancin' it up
We're jazzin' it up

[Verse]
All the boys are swingin' their hips
They're burnin' up the floor
And the girls, they're swingin' their skirts
We're beggin' them for more
And I'm so sick of doin' this dance
The same old step, but, oh, I like it
And I like you, and I know you do, too
So, baby, come on, let's move
(One, two, three, four)
